Démarrer, mettre en pause, reprendre et: Start, pause, resume and finish. Each member has one active entry; breaks are excluded and seconds are preserved.
Un widget déplaçable au-dessus des fenêt: A movable widget above ordinary windows, a system tray or menu bar icon and Ctrl/Cmd + Alt + M, subject to system support.
Ajoutez une durée comme 1h30 ou 90 min,: Add a duration such as 1h30 or 90 min, or a start/end interval with a UTC offset. Overlaps are detected and require confirmation.
Corrigez ou retirez un temps finalisé en: Correct or remove a completed entry with a reason. Editing only its description preserves its original segments and seconds. Changes are logged.
Noms, couleurs, descriptions, membres af: Names, colours, descriptions, assigned members and optional tasks. Search projects and archive them while keeping their history.
Contributeur, responsable et administrat: Contributors, managers and administrators have different permissions. Administrators create accounts, reset passwords and disable access.
Un serveur d’équipe rassemble les donnée: A team server brings the data together. Connected clients share accounts, projects, entries and permissions; changes are announced to connected clients.
Sur ordinateur, créez vos projets et sui: Create projects and track your work on desktop without a server or an online account. Notes, manual summaries and exports remain available locally.
Après une première connexion d’équipe, l: After an initial team sign-in, the desktop client saves timer actions and new entries before sending them. Conflicts remain visible and are preserved.
Associez explicitement les projets perso: Explicitly map personal projects to authorised team projects. Copy selected completed entries; the originals stay on your computer.
Associez une note à un projet et une dat: Attach a note to a project and date. Private notes stay personal; their author decides when to review and share them for reports.
Rédigez manuellement votre bilan du mois: Write your monthly review manually, then review and approve it for reports. Drafts stay private.
Les temps finalisés sont additionnés en: Completed entries are added up in seconds using the workspace time zone. Intervals crossing month boundaries are split, including daylight-saving changes.
Rapports personnels et, pour l’administr: Personal reports and, for administrators, collective reports. Server snapshots are private to their creator and downloadable for 24 hours.
Codex et Claude Code via MCP: Codex and Claude Code via MCP
Créez un jeton personnel limité dans le: Create a personal token with an expiry date and revoke it at any time. Read your projects and entries or propose a private note; controlling the timer requires an additional permission.
Ollama, vLLM ou Claude peuvent préparer: Ollama, vLLM or Claude can draft a summary after you consent to sending your descriptions and notes. Review the draft; AI does not change durations.
Une API pour les fonctions de l’applicat: An API for application features, and POST /hooks/work-notes to receive proposed private notes. Repeated deliveries of the same event are recognised.
Une instance et une base SQLite pour l’é: One instance and one SQLite database for your team. The server serves the interface, API and MCP. An HTTPS proxy gives your team access.
Sauvegardez la base SQLite et sa clé ave: Back up SQLite and its key with the supplied tool. Export shared work as JSON; on desktop, also back up the full app configuration folder.
L’interface et les guides sont disponibl: The app and user guides are available in three languages. Server report labels follow your chosen language; the content you write keeps its original language.
Dans un espace d’équipe, les accès sont: In a team workspace, the server checks access for every operation.
Ses temps, ses notes et ses rapports per: Their own entries, notes and personal reports; projects they are assigned to.
Gestion de tous les projets ; consultati: Manage all projects; view and correct team entries with a reason; access their personal report.
Droits du responsable, gestion des compt: Manager permissions plus accounts, access, integrations, the audit log and collective monthly exports.
En autonomie, vous gérez votre propre es: In standalone mode, you manage your own workspace. MCP tokens remain limited to their owner’s personal data, even for administrators.

Faut-il créer un compte pour travailler: Do I need an account to work on my own?
Sur l’application ordinateur, choisissez: In the desktop app, choose “Use on this computer”. Your personal workspace needs no online account or server. Its protection relies on your operating system account.
Puis-je rejoindre une équipe plus tard ?: Can I join a team later?
Oui. Les espaces restent distincts. Aprè: Yes. The workspaces stay separate. After signing in to the team, map personal projects to authorised team projects and choose completed entries to copy. Originals stay local; private notes are not transferred.
Fermer l’application arrête-t-il le chro: Does closing the app stop the timer?
Un chronomètre doit être terminé explici: Finish a timer explicitly. Closing a window, quitting or putting the computer to sleep does not automatically finish a local timer or one already received by the server.
Un assistant peut-il modifier mes heures: Can an assistant change my hours?
Les moteurs de rédaction produisent du t: Writing providers produce text and cannot change durations. An MCP assistant can control your timer only if you explicitly grant timer.write_own. It receives no permission to manually correct time entries.
En équipe, SQLite se trouve sur le serve: For a team, SQLite lives on your own server. On desktop, the personal workspace and sync outboxes live in the app’s private folder. Local files rely on operating system account protection, without independent encryption.
Le logiciel surveille-t-il mes fichiers: Does Minutrel monitor my files or screens?
Minutrel chronomètre le projet que vous: Minutrel tracks the project you choose. It does not automatically read folders, screenshots or conversations in other software. AI connections are optional.
Pour travailler seul, le client ordinate: The desktop client is enough for working alone. Install a team server to share work with others.
Installez ou construisez le client natif: Install or build the native client, then choose “Use on this computer”. There is no server to configure.
Téléchargez les sources, ouvrez leur dos: Download the source code, open its folder in a terminal and follow the Docker steps below.
Téléchargez et décompressez l’archive. L: Download and extract the archive. Run commands from the folder containing compose.yml and package.json.
Installez Docker avec Compose sur votre: Install Docker with Compose on your host, copy .env.example to .env and build the app. Without Docker, use Node.js 24.
Ouvrez l’adresse locale, saisissez le se: Open the local address, enter the setup secret and create the first administrator. Configure HTTPS for your team.
